# Tyler Pixel

> Portfolio of Tyler Patterson (Tyler Pixel), a design engineer in Brisbane,
> Australia, working on brand identity design and product engineering. The site
> is a single-page app: every URL below is a real, linkable route, but the HTML
> served at each one is the same shell, with the content rendered client-side.

Because the pages are rendered in the browser, fetching a route's HTML will not
show you the rendered content of that route. It will, however, give you all of
it: every page embeds the site's entire copy as JSON in a single tag,

    <script id="siteContent" type="application/json">…</script>

so one request for any URL above is enough to read the whole site. That tag is
the source of truth and is the better thing to parse.

## Sections

- [Intro](https://tylerpixel.com/): Who Tyler is and the companies whose teams use products he's worked on.
- [Selected Works](https://tylerpixel.com/work): Case studies for brand identity and product work.
- [Writing](https://tylerpixel.com/writing): Posts on design and building products.
- [Store](https://tylerpixel.com/store): Merchandise and digital goods, fulfilled by Fourthwall.
- [About](https://tylerpixel.com/about): Background, resume, and contact.

## Data

- All page copy, work case studies, and writing posts: embedded in every page as the `siteContent` JSON tag described above. There is no separate file to fetch.
- [legal.json](https://tylerpixel.com/data/legal.json): Terms, privacy policy, and returns policy. Fetched on demand when a policy page opens, so this one is still its own file.
